claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised his concert hall, Champion's Rest, at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, which was open every evening with free singers and dancers, with Allen in the chair.
claims.excerpt: CHAMPION’S Rest, 619 Market street. Tom Allen, the retired champion of the world, wishes to inform his friends

claims.statement: Tom Allen was described as the retired champion of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the retired champion of the world, wishes to inform his friends and the public

notes: A short advertisement in the paper's own words; the message to friends is not a direct quote.
